meta.title: Editorial review decisions (review_decisions, handover section 6)
meta.rule: One record per review decision. Reviewers are identified by role only, never by name (docs/data-protection-policy.md). The reviewer must not be the person who extracted the values. A value is shown as Approved only when an approved record names it and its source_sha256 equals the current hash of that source document.
